name: Q Monomer Liquid Acrylic Nail System
description:
The Q Monomer Liquid Acrylic Nail System is a professional-grade liquid monomer designed for use with acrylic powder to create strong, durable nail extensions and overlays. Formulated for maximum adhesion, it minimizes lifting and cracking, giving nails a long-lasting, salon-quality finish. Its self-leveling consistency makes it easy to work with, producing smooth, even beads for precise application. Packaged in a generous 120ml bottle, this monomer is ideal for nail technicians and salons looking for a reliable, high-performance product for everyday acrylic nail services.

How to Use:

  1. Prep and shape the natural nail.
  2. Dip your acrylic brush into the monomer liquid.
  3. Pick up acrylic powder to form a bead.
  4. Apply and sculpt onto the nail before the bead sets.
  5. Allow to air-dry, then file and shape as desired.

Warnings:
For professional/salon use. Use in a well-ventilated area. Avoid contact with skin and eyes. Keep out of reach of children.
